stepS.why: initial guess (sampling interval of the strips; fine enough for fights that last 10+ s)

refWindowS.why: initial guess, recalibrate in E13 (where the enemy was seen in the first seconds defines the attack axis when its spawn was not tracked)

ghostMaxS.why: initial guess, recalibrate in E13 (an enemy last seen longer ago than this is not counted on any flank)

even.why: initial guess, recalibrate in E13 (own HP share within 50% +- this on a flank counts as an even fight)

minForce.why: initial guess (below this much total HP on a flank nobody is really there)

behindRatio.why: initial guess, recalibrate in E13 (own HP share below this on a flank means that flank is being lost)

behindForS.why: initial guess, recalibrate in E13 (the flank must stay behind this long to count as an episode, so single hits do not)

respondWithinS.why: initial guess, recalibrate in E13 (a teammate who reaches the flank within this long after the episode starts counts as a responder)
